info.what: Data for addressable LEDs (NeoPixel). Rests low.
info.confirm: Every bit takes 1.25 µs (800 kHz). A short high pulse (about 0.4 µs) is 0, a long one (about 0.8 µs) is 1. Bits come in groups of 24 per LED.
info.decoderTips: One channel. Colour order is green, red, blue. You need at least 10 MHz sampling to see it properly.
info.lookalikes: An inverted UART also rests low, but its pulses come in many widths.

symptoms.cause: The colour order is green, red, blue
symptoms.action: Read the first byte as green.
